searchText: Hi everyone, is there a timeline for activating withdrawal on Eth2? we have some slashed validators and we want to reuse their locked ethers on another newly created validators. Can someone answer this question? This is getting serious on our side... The first hard fork after the merge So realistically ~2 months after the merge? when is the merge? Thanks Vitalik.. The targeted optimistic timeline is Q4 2021, but likely in Q1/Q2 2022 for the merge at the current moment Thank you for the clarification.
